description: Wanchain network activity per UTC day from OrbitWan's own index: transaction count (failed included), failed count, distinct senders, contract creations and the block range. With day, also that day's top 10 recipients and senders by transaction count. With from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 366 days; default the last 30 held days), the daily figures. Only days that have ended are held, so today is never included.
name: get_network_stats
title: Wanchain network activity per day
